items.title: How long do job postings really stay open? What 32,000 closed listings showed
items.pt:
I run a small job search engine that reads open roles straight from employers' own careers pages (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday and others) every hour. Because every listing is re-checked each hour, we see the moment an employer takes a posting down. After ten days of hourly checks, these are the first numbers on how long postings actually stay up.

items.title: PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.pt: Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model. We propose Physically Grounded Execution (PGX), a framework that offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components, allowing the VLA to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics. items.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
items.pt: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness.
